sample_policy: Original unchanged: five-sample median [min–max]. Upstream changed inputs: original single observations. Migration changed inputs: supplemental single observations on the same active NUC, pinned accepted implementation/protocol; accepted timing values are retained separately, not paired as one original cohort.

supplemental_environment.sample_policy: Single observation per changed-input case, matching accepted lifecycle protocol; supplementary timings do not replace accepted timings.
supplemental_environment.cache_state: Disposable pinned exports receive an unmeasured forced warm prime to replace relocated generated products, followed by each unchanged original harness normal baseline. Force equality and output restoration are required; dependencies reused outside timing, OS caches uncontrolled.
supplemental_environment.metric: GNU maximum individual process/phase RSS, KiB / 1024 = MiB; sampled 50ms descendant resident-page sum bytes / 1048576 = MiB, not PSS, shared pages double-counted and short peaks may be missed.
supplemental_environment.rejected_setup: Initial relocated-cache probe failed forced equality; raw attempt retained and excluded. Location-correct warm prime restored equality without implementation changes.
supplemental_environment.worker_scope: Four workers apply to the authored MDX compiler; rendered-source normal publication has no Markdown renderer.
supplemental_environment.nift_identity_basis: Exact frozen original installed v4.8.0 executable SHA-256; no source commit was recorded for this binary.
supplemental_environment.dependency_policy: Accepted locked dependencies reused via read-only-in-practice node_modules symlinks; no install or package upgrade in this campaign.
